ports.name: cmos_vsync
ports.internal_core: not connected; RTL register has no downstream use and is pruned

ports.name: cmos_pclk
ports.internal_core: same-name input, directly connected; generates internal cmos_aresetn counter state

ports.name: cmos_d[9:0]
ports.internal_core: cmos_d[7:0] receives RTL cmos_d[9:2]; RTL bits [1:0] unused; no bit reversal

ports.name: m_axis_video_aclk
ports.internal_core: same-name input, directly connected; independent clock

ports.name: m_axis_video_aresetn
ports.internal_core: not connected; RTL data path does not consume this port

ports.name: m_axis_video_tready
ports.internal_core: same-name input, directly connected; bind to 1 for this configured instance

ports.name: m_axis_video_tkeep[1:0]
ports.internal_core: both bits tied to 1; no internal core port

scope_exclusions: SCCB/sensor-control signals are outside the RTL/XCI/netlist boundary.
